test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

A raven, which you know is black as coal, was envious of the swan, because her __feathers are as white as__ the purest snow.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. feathers were as white as .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined segment refers to the description of the swan’s feathers. The correct verb tense must match the context of the sentence.
 
• The sentence is in past tense ("was envious"), so the correct verb form should also be in past tense.
 
• Option 2, "feathers were as white as," correctly uses the past tense verb "were," aligning with the sentence structure.

Correct sentence: *A raven, which you know is black as coal, was envious of the swan, because her **feathers were as white as** the purest snow*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subject-Verb Agreement:**
 
 
• The verb must agree with the subject in both number and tense.
 
• In this sentence, "feathers" is plural, and the past tense verb "were" correctly agrees with it.
 
 
 
• **Contextual Consistency:**
 
 
• The sentence describes a past situation, so using "is" or "was" (present or singular forms) would be grammatically incorrect.
